7547.title: Provider badge disappears with a server-only directory
7547.rootCauseOneLine: The sidebar uses the primary-host provider directory and omits the entire badge when a remote thread provider is missing.
7547.proposedFix: Resolve sidebar provider metadata using thread environment or host scope with deduplicated requests, without silently widening the public provider-list contract.
7547.caveats: Component failure repeated in two clean trusted checkouts; no live remote agent or browser screenshot. Headless browser setup lacks Chrome. No automatic PR for a partial reproduction.
